reasons.requirements: All seven acceptance criteria are covered by the spec and the diff, including the UTC and done-todo overdue rule, which the spec was updated to match.
reasons.scope: The change stays within the ticket; the extra plan and spec docs and the .gitignore entry for Playwright artifacts are minor additions.
reasons.tests: Store and API tests cover validation, PATCH set/clear, and overdue edge cases, but the UI is only checked for the filter's testid and the existing test was only extended.
reasons.conventions: The change uses ValidationError mapped to 400, adds data-testid on the new elements, has no new dependencies, and follows the existing test style.
reasons.architecture: The overdue predicate is duplicated in app.mjs and index.html, and the filtering logic sits in the route handler instead of the store.
reasons.codeQuality: The code is clear and the date validation is strict, but the overdue logic is duplicated and the page's initial load has no error handling.
